description: MPCPy is a Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory Python package for testing and implementing occupant-integrated model predictive control in buildings. Four modules import data, interact with real or emulated systems, estimate and validate simplified physical or statistical models, and optimise control inputs. Modelica and the Functional Mockup Interface provide the model and simulator connection. Source, a user guide and an introductory tutorial are public on GitHub. Coverage is a user-specified building or system; the package has no fixed location, observation period or spatial grid. It is free under the repository's modified three-clause BSD terms. Important limitations are its Python 2.7 and Ubuntu 16.04 development environment and reliance on the open JModelica version, whose support ended in December 2019 according to the README. Those dependencies require checking before a new deployment. MPCPy supports building-control experiments and calibration workflows. It can work with Modelica-based building models such as the catalogue's Modelica Buildings library (model-modelica-buildings-library); this review did not test a particular combination or controller.
